sourceTitle: The AI Bubble Survives on Hidden Debt
title: AI Spending vs The Revenue It Earns
hook: AI spending, drawn against the revenue it earns.
question: Does that gap ever close?

scenes.narration: Let's draw AI spending directly against the revenue it currently earns. Almost immediately, a very large gap opens up.
Combined annual AI build-out is now north of three hundred billion dollars. The revenue it earns so far is only a fraction of that.
All that spending is capital expenditure. The bet is you spend now and earn it back later.
Nobody doubts the boom itself is real, and moving incredibly fast.
The concentration is just as striking. Roughly a third of the entire stock index now sits in a handful of AI giants.

shots.label: of the index, in a few names

scenes.narration: And a growing share of that build-out is funded by borrowing, through corporate bonds.
So the real question is simple. Does that gap between spending and revenue ever actually close?
